newsitem.title: USA: Artra Group unit buys niche bag maker.
newsitem.headline: Artra Group unit buys niche bag maker.

text.p: Artra Group Inc said Friday its Bagcraft Corporation of America unit acquired the assets of the Alfred J. Bleyer Division of Fonda Group Inc.
Bleyer's operations, which make specialty packaging for baked goods, will be relocated to Chicago from Maspeth, N.Y., a Bagcraft spokesman said.
The deal is Bagcraft's second purchase of a specialty bag manufacturing company in the last month. Bagcraft is a manufacturer of flexible packaging.
Artra Group has operations in the costume jewelry, packaging, chemical and laboratory equipment industries.
Its stock was down 1/8 Friday morning at 6.
